project_extensions.scope: Collider MC: exact external LHE input, controlled QED FSR, and standard HepMC truth projection.

acceptance_criteria: Exact raw LHE, official pinned Pythia 8.317.0 and native HepMC3 writer wheels, same first 128 and seed 314159.
Both modes select and accept 128; physical beam and muon IDs and stable statuses; zero FSR-off photons and a positive FSR-on resolved-photon sample.
Four-momentum balance <=1e-5 GeV and nominal weight/total cross-section residual <=1e-7 pb.
Stable beam/final HepMC projection roundtrip preserves GeV/mm, PDGs, statuses, weights and vectors; fail on wrong units/input.
